The consumer-side receipt is attributed to '#835 §III(2)', but seated #835 (v1.2, and v1.3 #1215) has no receipt or consumer-side-artifact prediction; its §III is a five-stage forecast.

Conformance fixtures are attributed to '#835 §III(3)', but seated #835 contains no fixture or conformance prediction, and the deposit's own §I (line 68) lists the third pressure as producer-side lifecycle.
Issue #207 is called the spec surface '#835 §IV' forecast for producer-side lifecycle, but seated #835 §IV is the Three Compressions frame and its text contains no deletion or lifecycle prediction.

The 'central claim (#835 §V)' that the gap would close by pressure from within the spec's working style is not in seated #835, whose §V is the empirical anchor and whose forecast is a correction forced by enterprise and regulatory pressure (F835.A5).

observations: #1263 quotes the marker 'directive language treating unlicensed semantic influence as attack' as a confirmation marker, but in #1209 it stands in falsifier (e) at line 197; F1209.A1's falsifier_quote stops at (d), so (e) is not carried in any find.

#1088/#1090 attribute a three-pressure forecast (producer-side summarization governance, consumer-side receipts, lifecycle/fixtures) to '#835 §III(1)-(3)', '§IV' and '§V'. Seated #835 (v1.2) and its v1.3 (#1215) hold a five-stage forecast (§III), the Three Compressions (§IV) and the empirical anchor (§V), with no receipt, fixture or lifecycle prediction. Items F1088.C3-C5 and F1090.C1 are therefore unlocated; the three-pressure statement appears first in #1088 §I (lines 64-70). Recorded as an apparent discrepancy, not an error.
#1088 itself lists the third pressure as producer-side lifecycle at line 68 and as conformance fixtures at line 367.
#921's metadata says the termination 'confirmed' the central prediction while its body (line 531) says consistent with, not pre-registered; the link records what the C find claims.
#1425 also records #916's commitment 'Reclassification will follow' as kept (came_true); the decision-level claimed value is 'failed' for the divergence hypothesis the C find quotes.

F1455.C2's registered NAE prediction lives in the battery_v02.py header; the linked statement is #1454 H3 (F1454.G3). F1456.C2's ten tests live in the battery_v03.py header (commit c7e5b4e7) and are restated in #1456's body, so it is recorded as self.
